=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_resolve_review_threads.sh:264 | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The reply endpoint incorrectly includes the PR number instead of using `pulls/comments/${comment_id}/replies`.
  WHY: Ignored-disposition replies receive 404 and the thread is resolved without the editor’s reason; deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro and minimax_minimax-m3 dispute this finding, stating the endpoint is documented and correct.
- scripts/review_resolve_review_threads_plan.py:43-47 and 95-100 | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `extract_disposition` returns the first declaration-ordered regex match anywhere in the full audit line, including free-form reason text.
  WHY: Competing disposition terms in reasons misclassify applied, ignored, or already-satisfied entries and trigger the wrong reply behavior.
- scripts/review_resolve_review_threads.sh:255-277 | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: When an ignored-disposition reply POST fails, execution still resolves the thread.
  WHY: The thread can be closed without the editor’s reason being visible.
- scripts/review_resolve_review_threads_plan.py:41-46 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The ignored disposition pattern omits `not addressed`, `not fixed`, `not present`, and `not done`.
  WHY: These phrases can be misclassified as applied or left unmatched, misrepresenting editor intent.
- scripts/review_resolve_review_threads_plan.py:230-251 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: The code assumes comment IDs are integers across the shell-to-Python boundary.
  WHY: String-versus-integer IDs may silently produce an empty plan; severity disagreement exists, with mistralai_mistral-small-2603 rating this nit.
- scripts/review_resolve_review_threads_plan.py:150-175 | severity=nit | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: Disposition patterns may not recognize common phrasings such as “already addressed” or “already fixed”.
  WHY: Such comments might not be classified as already satisfied.
- scripts/review_resolve_review_threads_plan.py:195-210 | severity=nit | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: `normalize_path` strips leading `./` but does not handle paths beginning with `../`.
  WHY: Relative paths such as `../src/app.ts` may fail to match context paths.
- scripts/review_resolve_review_threads_plan.py:210 | severity=nit | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: `REVIEW_RESOLVE_THREADS_MAX=0` is coerced to 50.
  WHY: An explicit zero cap is silently changed into resolving up to the default 50 threads.
- scripts/review_resolve_review_threads_plan.py:209-214 | severity=nit | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Cap truncation reports dropped comment IDs in one excessively long warning line.
  WHY: Operators may be unable to read or conveniently correlate the dropped IDs.
- scripts/review_resolve_review_threads.sh:196-202 | severity=nit | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Unrecognized dispositions are logged and dropped without fallback or notification.
  WHY: An audit entry can vanish indistinguishably from an omitted entry.
- scripts/review_resolve_review_threads.sh:264 | severity=nit | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Multi-line editor reasons may be truncated or flattened in the reply body.
  WHY: The reply body is passed through `gh api -f body=...`, and the reported transport behavior is plausible but not demonstrated.
- scripts/review_resolve_review_threads.sh:264 and ignored disposition branch | severity=nit | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The fixed ignored-thread reply promises that the AI autofix pipeline will pick up a reopened thread on the next iteration.
  WHY: Surrounding skip paths do not contractually guarantee that behavior.
- scripts/review_resolve_review_threads_plan.py:260-285 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: Plan-file writing is not validated.
  WHY: Disk or permission failures can produce no plan while the script exits successfully.
- scripts/review_resolve_review_threads.sh:1-286 | severity=nit | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: GraphQL mutation responses are not properly validated or parsed for malformed or missing expected fields.
  WHY: Threads may fail to resolve without an emitted error.
- scripts/review_resolve_review_threads.sh:145-165 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: `RESOLVE_TMP_DIR` creation with `mktemp` is not validated.
  WHY: If `mktemp` fails, the script continues with an empty or invalid temporary directory.
- scripts/review_resolve_review_threads.sh:145-165 | severity=nit | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: The script does not validate successful JSON parsing of the plan file.
  WHY: Malformed JSON can make `jq` fail silently, yielding empty thread IDs and skipped resolutions.
- scripts/review_resolve_review_threads.sh:215-235 | severity=nit | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: An empty threads list from GraphQL is not explicitly handled.
  WHY: The script processes empty data without an appropriate early exit.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:4080-4107 versus 4124+ | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Thread resolution runs before and independently of the detector verifying that editor-claimed changes were committed.
  WHY: Lost applied edits can leave threads resolved despite missing fixes; minimax_minimax-m3 explicitly rejects this as a defect.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:4090-4110 | severity=nit | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: The workflow does not set `REVIEW_THREADS_RESOLVED_COUNT` in `GITHUB_ENV` when the file is available.
  WHY: Subsequent steps cannot access the resolved-thread count; moonshotai_kimi-k3 disputes this finding.

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/review_resolve_review_threads_plan.py
  Line or code reference: lines 43-46 (DISPOSITION_PATTERNS) and lines 96-100 (extract_disposition)
  Problem: extract_disposition runs each declaration-ordered regex against the entire audit bullet, including the free-form reason text that follows the disposition, and returns the first hit rather than the disposition token itself.
  WHY: An applied entry whose reason contains skipped can be misclassified as ignored, while an ignored entry whose reason contains already addressed can be misclassified as already satisfied.
  severity=major | confidence=4
- scripts/review_resolve_review_threads.sh
  Line or code reference: lines 259-281
  Problem: When the ignored-disposition reply POST fails, the script logs a warning but still proceeds to the resolveReviewThread mutation.
  WHY: The thread is resolved without the editor’s reason.
  severity=major | confidence=4
- scripts/review_resolve_review_threads.sh and scripts/review_resolve_review_threads_plan.py
  Line or code reference: shell lines 147-149; python lines 207-213
  Problem: REVIEW_RESOLVE_THREADS_MAX=0 is silently coerced to the default 50.
  WHY: An operator who sets the cap to zero intending to resolve no threads will instead have up to 50 threads resolved.
  severity=nit | confidence=3
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/review_resolve_review_threads.sh
  Line or code reference: line 264, in the `ignored` disposition reply branch
  Problem: The shell `printf '%s' "..."` wraps the editor's reason into a reply body passed via `gh api -f body=...`; reasons containing newlines may be silently truncated.
  WHY: The reply body meant to be visible to reviewers can be silently truncated when the editor’s reason contains embedded newlines.
  severity=nit | confidence=2
- scripts/review_resolve_review_threads_plan.py
  Line or code reference: DISPOSITION_PATTERNS tuple at lines 42-46 and extract_disposition() at lines 95-100
  Problem: `extract_disposition()` walks the three patterns in declaration order and returns the first pattern that matches anywhere in the audit line, including inside the free-form reason text after the actual disposition token.
  WHY: Misclassification of disposition means the wrong action is taken on the wrong thread.
  severity=major | confidence=4
- scripts/review_resolve_review_threads.sh
  Line or code reference: lines 253-277, the `ignored` disposition branch
  Problem: When the `gh_retry gh api .../replies` call fails, the script still proceeds to the `resolveReviewThread` mutation.
  WHY: The thread resolves with no visible reason.
  severity=major | confidence=4
- scripts/review_resolve_review_threads_plan.py
  Line or code reference: lines 244-249, `if not raw_id.isdigit()` and `int(raw_id)` on line 251
  Problem: The plan script reads comment IDs as strings while the GraphQL thread map may use integers.
  WHY: A valid PR can produce a 0-thread plan with `resolved=0`.
  severity=major | confidence=3
- scripts/review_resolve_review_threads_plan.py
  Line or code reference: lines 41-46, the `ignored` disposition regex
  Problem: The `ignored` regex does not match common reviewer phrasings such as “not addressed”, “not fixed”, “not present”, or “not done”.
  WHY: An ignored entry can be reclassified as applied.
  severity=major | confidence=3
- scripts/review_resolve_review_threads.sh
  Line or code reference: lines 196-202, the `extract_disposition` failure path in `parse_audit_entries`
  Problem: An empty disposition is logged and skipped.
  WHY: The entry is dropped without the editor’s knowledge.
  severity=nit | confidence=3
- scripts/review_resolve_review_threads_plan.py
  Line or code reference: lines 209-214, the cap-truncation branch
  Problem: Dropped comment IDs are emitted in one excessively long warning line.
  WHY: The warning is difficult to read in the Actions log.
  severity=nit | confidence=3
- scripts/review_resolve_review_threads.sh
  Line or code reference: line 264, the reply body string, and `disposition=ignored` branch as a whole
  Problem: The reply promises that the AI autofix pipeline will pick up a reopened thread on the next iteration.
  WHY: Surrounding skip paths do not guarantee that behavior.
  severity=nit | confidence=4
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
